task.title: Change the VSCode extensions icon to something more relevant
task.description: Replace the current VSCode extension icon with a new icon that better represents Festina Lente's identity and purpose as a structured task workflow tool.
task.problem: The current VSCode extension icon doesn't clearly represent what Festina Lente does, making it hard to identify in the sidebar and marketplace.
task.value: A recognizable, relevant icon improves the extension's visual identity across the sidebar, activity bar, and marketplace, making it easier for users to find and associate with Festina Lente's purpose.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the VSCode extension is installed When a user views the activity bar or sidebar Then the extension icon visually represents Festina Lente's identity And it is not a generic kanban board or checklist icon
Given the icon is displayed at various sizes When rendered at small sizes (16x16 in the activity bar) Then the icon remains clear and recognizable
Given a user is using any VSCode theme When the extension icon is displayed Then it renders correctly in both light and dark themes
Given the extension is published When a user views the marketplace listing Then the new icon appears as the extension icon in package.json And it is visible in the activity bar and marketplace listing
